purpose: Maintenance diagnosis of CUDA allocator reservation dependence on per-epoch CudaPrefetcher side streams. Not a forecast family, SCALAR rescue, or production change.
hypothesis: Repeated construction obtains distinct allocator-associated side streams; reusing one prefetcher may reduce reservations while preserving loader order and the exact deterministic consumer trace.
only_arm_difference: if arm == per_epoch or current is None: current = exact_AST_CudaPrefetcher(loader,device); otherwise retain same object

fixture.allocation: allocate and fill pinned destination directly; zero-copy memoryview SHA256; no full-size copy

consumer.model: FP32 deterministic channel mean over 20,000 rows, linear 211→2+bias; no recurrent model/AMP/EMA
consumer.loss: mean of per-sequence squared two-output error times mean(scored*prop)

allocator.limitation: No allocator pressure intervention; equal end-of-epoch guard aborts if natural peak exceeds 5GiB. No partial result qualifies the hypothesis.

boundaries.explicit_sync: one initial and one after each epoch; no per-batch synchronize/readback
boundaries.stream_ids: record actual cuda_stream at each epoch; require four distinct per_epoch and one reused
boundaries.timings: all four epochs; primary loop wall includes prefetch creation, copy/consumer/trace loops, equal epoch sync, trace readback, memory/RNG recording and boundary JSON output; excludes fixture/model setup and final NPZ save. Also report per-epoch wall and external full-process wall.

parity.CPU_fixture: whole pinned tensors SHA256 and byte/dtype/shape plus actual loader order
parity.device_batch: integer-bit checksum for x/y/prop and scored count, plus complete per-sequence feature means and target means; these checksums are not a cryptographic proof of whole GPU tensor identity
parity.RNG: CPU, CUDA and fixture private-generator state hashes before loop and at every epoch boundary
parity.traces: all 128 losses, gradients, updated model parameter vectors, feature means, targets and checksums; exact dtype/shape/bytes across NPZ arrays; also exact initial/final parameter arrays
parity.storage: small GPU trace clones retained to equal epoch boundary, then copied to CPU; no per-batch host sync
parity.required: all finite, nontrivial model update and exact trace/fixture/RNG identity

gate.first: complete both arms without resource/time/correctness failure; no retries
gate.no_filtering: all four epochs included; no removal of unfavorable timing, no adaptive workload change
gate.success: engineering evidence only; no production source change authorized
gate.otherwise: close maintenance hypothesis; preserve every partial log/sample and both completed-arm receipts

resources.GPU_precondition: >=6144MiB free and no compute process; rechecked before each arm
resources.signal_identity: only owned PID/start_ticks/process-group; no unrelated job signaling
resources.limit_caveats: cgroup host cap is kernel enforced; NVML sampling may miss transient peaks; SIGALRM scheduling is not a hard real-time guarantee
resources.GPU_memory_measurement: both total GPU memory.used and own process used_memory, retaining foreign compute process rejection

change_from_v1: Only resource enforcement: verify cgroup cpu.max==400000 100000 and query/enforce total GPU memory.used<=5632MiB; retain per-process usage and foreign-owner guard. Fixture, consumer, arm order, timing and gates unchanged.
